title: What is the Trust Center?
summary: The Trust Center brings together publicly available feedback, professional recognition and community impact connected to EV.ENGINEER™ and iTelematics Software in one place, with clear labels for where each piece of content comes from and how it was verified.

title: How is content on this page verified?
summary: Every item is labelled with its source and a verification status: verified, externally published, manually curated, pending verification, or placeholder. We do not fabricate reviews, ratings or quotes, and we never combine ratings from different platforms into a single misleading score.

title: Why are some sections hidden or marked coming soon?
summary: Sections only appear once there is real, approved content to show. Rather than display empty or fabricated placeholders, incomplete sections are hidden or clearly marked as being curated until verified content is available.

title: What is the difference between EV.ENGINEER, iTelematics Software and EV Society?
summary: EV.ENGINEER™ is the engineering training and consulting platform. iTelematics Software Private Limited is the operating company behind it, and is the entity referenced in workplace feedback such as Glassdoor. EV Society™ is an independent community organisation whose candidate projects are featured here as community and engineering impact, not as customer feedback.

title: Does the Trust Center search use AI?
summary: The Trust Center Search is a deterministic, local keyword search over approved content only — it is not an AI-generated response. If there isn't enough verified information to answer a question, it says so instead of guessing.
